web.title: RISC-V FPU Register Optimization for Matrix Multiplication
web.description: This project explores reducing memory access overhead in RISC-V matrix multiplication by leveraging Floating Point Unit (FPU) registers as temporary storage. The optimized implementation replaces repeated memory accesses with register-level operations and evaluates the resulting performance improvements using the gem5 architectural simulator.
